recommendation: Keep the commit as-is; it completes the published Jira resolution in active MedicationDispense source without broadening the change beyond the approved sentence.
issue_request: FHIR-31016 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R5. It requested replacing the statement that a medication dispense is the result of a pharmacy system responding to a medication order with the approved wording that it can be the result of a pharmacy system responding to a medication request.
initial_application: Commit 7453f87bfcb5eeba6020113412508cb95e5d4f0a was the only direct source-history application found for FHIR-31016. It changed the MedicationDispense introduction from "is" to "can" but left "medication order" and did not update the root StructureDefinition description/definition. Later FHIR-44999 history touched the same root element for an invariant fix and restored the stale definition, but did not make an order/request wording decision.
additional_context: MedicationDispense is active current-build source through source/fhir.ini. The unresolved wording appeared in both the narrative introduction and the authoritative StructureDefinition root description/definition. Targeted Zulip and Confluence searches found no relevant community record that narrowed or reversed the Jira resolution.
reconciliation: Updated source/medicationdispense/medicationdispense-introduction.xml and source/medicationdispense/structuredefinition-MedicationDispense.xml so the current build consistently uses the approved "can ... medication request" wording. AuthorizingPrescription-specific "medication order" text was left unchanged because it is a separate element concept and not the sentence resolved by this issue.

source/medicationdispense/structuredefinition-MedicationDispense.xml: changed the resource description and root differential definition from the stale "is ... medication order" wording to "can ... medication request".
